title: Siphon Squad Tribute loop with self-resummoning Death
notes: Classic #88 Siphon Squad's Tribute condition holds nothing on a body that is not Siphon Squad itself and arrived this turn (R2500000), ending the loop when fused or granted with Job Application's self-resummoning Death.

player.title: Siphon Squad Tribute loop fix
fixes: Siphon Squad no longer enters an infinite Tribute loop when fused or granted with Job Application.
